+    return not isinstance(value, bool) and isinstance(value, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(value)
+
+
+def require_finite_numbers(value: Any, *, path: str = "<root>") -> list[str]:
+    errors: list[str] = []
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        for key, child in value.items():
+            errors.extend(require_finite_numbers(child, path=f"{path}.{key}"))
+    elif isinstance(value, list):
+        for index, child in enumerate(value):
+            errors.extend(require_finite_numbers(child, path=f"{path}[{index}]"))
+    elif isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
+        errors.append(f"non_finite_number:{path}")
+    return errors
+

+def exact_set_errors(expected: Iterable[Any], observed: Iterable[Any], *, label: str) -> list[str]:
+    expected_list = list(expected)
+    observed_list = list(observed)
+    errors: list[str] = []
+    if len(expected_list) != len(set(expected_list)):
+        errors.append(f"duplicate_expected_key:{label}")
+    if len(observed_list) != len(set(observed_list)):
+        errors.append(f"duplicate_observed_key:{label}")
+    if errors:
+        return errors
+    expected_set = set(expected_list)
+    observed_set = set(observed_list)
+    if len(expected_set) != len(observed_set):
+        errors.append(f"unique_cardinality_mismatch:{label}")
+    if expected_set - observed_set:
+        errors.append(f"missing_members:{label}:{sorted(expected_set - observed_set)}")
+    if observed_set - expected_set:
+        errors.append(f"extra_members:{label}:{sorted(observed_set - expected_set)}")
+    return errors
+

+def _has_cycle(dependencies: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]) -> bool:
+    temporary: set[str] = set()
+    permanent: set[str] = set()
+
+    def visit(node: str) -> bool:
+        if node in permanent:
+            return False
+        if node in temporary:
+            return True
+        temporary.add(node)
+        if any(visit(parent) for parent in dependencies.get(node, ())):
+            return True
+        temporary.remove(node)
+        permanent.add(node)
+        return False
+
+    return any(visit(node) for node in dependencies)
+

+def validate_active_issue_manifest(
+    manifest: dict[str, Any], schema: dict[str, Any]
+) -> list[str]:
+    errors = json_schema_errors(manifest, schema)
+    children = manifest.get("active_children", [])
+    child_ids = [child.get("child_id") for child in children if isinstance(child, dict)]
+    if len(child_ids) != len(set(child_ids)):
+        errors.append("duplicate_child")
+    if set(child_ids) != set(EXPECTED_CHILDREN):
+        errors.append(f"active_children_must_equal_A01_A08:{sorted(set(child_ids))}")
+
+    dependencies: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {}
+    roles: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for child in children:
+        if not isinstance(child, dict):
+            continue
+        child_id = child.get("child_id")
+        declared = tuple(child.get("dependencies", []))
+        dependencies[str(child_id)] = declared
+        if child_id in EXPECTED_DEPENDENCIES and set(declared) != set(EXPECTED_DEPENDENCIES[child_id]):
+            errors.append(f"invalid_dependency:{child_id}:{list(declared)}")
+        unknown = set(declared) - set(EXPECTED_CHILDREN)
+        if unknown:
+            errors.append(f"unknown_dependency:{child_id}:{sorted(unknown)}")
+        owner_role = child.get("owner_role")
+        if owner_role in roles:
+            errors.append(f"role_conflict:{owner_role}:{roles[owner_role]}:{child_id}")
+        elif isinstance(owner_role, str):
+            roles[owner_role] = str(child_id)
+        budget = child.get("budget", {})
+        if budget.get("provider_calls_enabled") is not False or budget.get("provider_call_cap") != 0:
+            errors.append(f"budget_not_default_deny:{child_id}")
+        for frozen_input in child.get("frozen_inputs", []):
+            input_hash = frozen_input.get("sha256")
+            if frozen_input.get("availability") == "parent_creation_contract":
+                if not SHA256_RE.fullmatch(str(input_hash or "")):
+                    errors.append(f"missing_frozen_input_hash:{child_id}:{frozen_input.get('path')}")
+                else:
+                    input_path = ARTIFACT_ROOT / str(frozen_input.get("path", ""))
+                    if input_path.is_file() and sha256_file(input_path) != input_hash:
+                        errors.append(f"frozen_input_hash_mismatch:{child_id}:{frozen_input.get('path')}")
+    if _has_cycle(dependencies):
+        errors.append("dependency_cycle")
+
+    contexts = manifest.get("a08_isolated_contexts", [])
+    context_ids = [item.get("context_id") for item in contexts if isinstance(item, dict)]
+    if tuple(context_ids) != REQUIRED_A08_CONTEXTS:
+        errors.append("a08_contexts_must_be_V_A_P_R_Q_in_one_child")
+    if manifest.get("issue_creation_policy", {}).get("instantiate_wbs_units") is not False:
+        errors.append("wbs_auto_instantiation_not_forbidden")
+    if manifest.get("issue_creation_policy", {}).get("max_campaign_a_child_issues") != 8:
+        errors.append("campaign_a_child_issue_cap_must_be_8")
+    manifest_body = dict(manifest)
+    recorded_manifest_sha = manifest_body.pop("manifest_sha256", None)
+    if recorded_manifest_sha != canonical_sha256(manifest_body):
+        errors.append("manifest_sha256_mismatch")
+    return sorted(set(errors))

+def _git(*args: str, check: bool = True) -> str:
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", *args],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        check=check,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    return result.stdout.strip()

+def origin_main_sha() -> str:
+    return _git("rev-parse", "origin/main")

+def path_exists_on_origin_main(path: Path) -> bool:
+    relative = path.resolve().relative_to(ROOT.resolve()).as_posix()
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "cat-file", "-e", f"origin/main:{relative}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    return result.returncode == 0
